worker_claim.report: Placement: focused `execution_provenance.py`, because accepted-generation resolution and exact Git-history proof are broader than report storage; `ExecutionReportStore` remains unchanged. The module reuses the existing exact lifecycle semantics and is now also called by recovery's `_lifecycle_commit_is_exact`; runtime shrank from 8957 to 8861 LOC, with 226 LOC added in the provenance module and no resolver algorithm or Markdown interpretation added to runtime. Added read-only Git observations are one history scan for the ticket's executions directory, followed by bounded exact-proof observations per candidate; no fetch, push, ref update, worktree mutation, or network operation is performed. Focused integration, recovery, execution-report tests, compilation, Ruff, and diff checks pass.
worker_claim.summary: Added read-only execution provenance resolution in `execution_provenance.py` and delegated accepted execution lookup from `runtime.py`. The resolver identifies exact report-plus-`todo -> review` lifecycle commits, supports only explicitly marked append-only curator notes, and rejects altered review content with an actionable diagnostic. Added regressions for the TASK-071 curator-note history and unclassified review edits.
